title: Smart Data Models - CAMARA APIs - CellPopulationDensityData
description: Population density data of a cell in a concrete time range. In case of insufficient data, to guarantee an anonymized prediction due to the k-anonymity within a specific cell and time range, no population density data is returned and the property `dataType` value is "LOW_DENSITY". In case of a cell not supported `dataType` value is "NO_DATA" (CAMARA population-density-data 1.0.0, PopulationDensityData release r4.3, OpenAPI component CellPopulationDensityData; field names kept verbatim.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:CellPopulationDensityData:<geohash>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CellPopulationDensityData'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

geohash.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/camaraproject/PopulationDensityData/r4.3/code/API_definitions/population-density-data.yaml#/components/schemas/CellPopulationDensityData/properties/geohash'. Geohash string identifying a cell using the [Geohash system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geohash), encoding a geographic location into a short string. Characters are taken from the base-32 geohash alphabet (`0-9` and `b-z` excluding `a`, `i`, `l`, `o`). The length of the string determines the cell granularity (precision).

dataType.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/camaraproject/PopulationDensityData/r4.3/code/API_definitions/population-density-data.yaml#/components/schemas/CellPopulationDensityData/properties/dataType'. Type of population density data returned for the cell, the possible values are: - `DENSITY_ESTIMATION`: The population density estimation is returned for the cell. - `LOW_DENSITY`: The data related to the cell is not sufficient to guarantee k-anonymity, so no population density estimation is returned. - `NO_DATA`: The cell is outside the MNO coverage area, so no population density data is returned.

minPplDensity.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/camaraproject/PopulationDensityData/r4.3/code/API_definitions/population-density-data.yaml#/components/schemas/DensityEstimation/allOf/1/properties/minPplDensity'. Minimum estimated number of people for the cell.

pplDensity.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/camaraproject/PopulationDensityData/r4.3/code/API_definitions/population-density-data.yaml#/components/schemas/DensityEstimation/allOf/1/properties/pplDensity'. Estimated number of people for the cell.

maxPplDensity.description: Property. Model:'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/camaraproject/PopulationDensityData/r4.3/code/API_definitions/population-density-data.yaml#/components/schemas/DensityEstimation/allOf/1/properties/maxPplDensity'. Maximum estimated number of people for the cell.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Not a CAMARA field (Smart Data Models addition): a GeoJSON Polygon built from the bounding box of the `geohash` cell, so that NGSI-LD geo-queries work. The CAMARA object is kept unchanged.
